intro: Sara Timberlain is a skilled tailor residing at the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. Known for her resourceful needlework with salvaged fabrics, she assists the war effort by stitching cloth and leather armaments for the Stormwind Army.

p: Situated outside a small cottage on the western edge of the Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain works tirelessly with needle and thread amidst the ambient noise of felling axes. Despite the remote nature of Eastvale and the looming threat of prowling wolves and murlocs, she provides hospitality and vital craftwork to travelers. Her talent for turning scraps of linen and salvaged bandanas into durable gear has earned her official recognition, securing commissions to supply protective cloth and leather armaments directly to Stormwind's military forces.
